request.style: English, spoken word poetry, a calm male voice speaking rhythmic lines over ambient piano and soft cello, a quiet female voice singing the short refrain, intimate and reflective, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
For everything there is a season
A time for every matter under heaven
A time to be born, and a time to die
A time to plant, and a time to uproot what was planted
A time to tear down, and a time to build

[Chorus]
He has made everything beautiful in its time
Eternity set in our hearts

[Verse]
A time to weep, and a time to laugh
A time to mourn, and a time to dance
A time to embrace, and a time to let go
A time to keep silent, and a time to speak
A time for war, and a time for peace

[Chorus]
He has made everything beautiful in its time
Eternity set in our hearts

[Outro]
Everything beautiful in its time
